correctness.rationale: With one attempt stopped by absorption or exponential reset, its mean duration is (1-a_r)/r and its success probability is a_r. Renewal is valid because initial and reset draws have the same law; the killed interval resolvent gives the stated cosh transform. For the difference of two laws with at most N atoms, normalization adds the q=0 row to the 2N-1 positive rate rows. For K distinct folded nodes in the signed support, choose K rows: Cauchy–Binet for the even power series has nonnegative terms by generalized Vandermonde/Schur positivity, with a strictly positive ordinary Vandermonde term in the squared nodes on both axes. This also handles q=0 or t=0. On the quadratic grid, triangular Chebyshev conversion and Hankel rank find the actual atom count, and the leading positive definite block, annihilator roots and Vandermonde solve give exactly the nodes and masses. An independent rational instance L=4, D=1, q=log 2, t=(0,1), w=(1/4,3/4) gives scaled means (15/19,198/59,3675/422), Hankel determinant 3/256 and annihilator (Z-1)(Z-5/4). The open ordered interior model has dimension 2N-1, so invariance of domain gives the asserted continuous-data lower bound, including the trivial zero-probe obstruction for N=1. Entire transform equality on an open interval gives all even moments, which identify the pushforward by t^2 on the compact closure. Only folded sites are identified; the count uses a known upper bound, and no noisy-data stability or arbitrary-grid algebraic inversion is asserted. Frozen verification notes are not independent certification.
